basis: 80k fixed-init3 archived robot state is identical at decision0 but raw/applied actions differ at decision0 across all four repeats; 4/5 success does not meet stability gate.

hypotheses.H_input: Reported benchmark init and robot state match but full first policy input differs (pixels, language or preprocessed tensors).
hypotheses.H_loading: Some model/processor state differs after checkpoint loading despite identical checkpoint files; evaluator seeds only after loading and reset.
hypotheses.H_rng_numeric: Identical full input, model/processor state and RNG state still yield different first actions under current numerical settings.

alternatives.reason: 40k to 80k yielded two gains and two regressions, no net paired benefit; does not isolate first-action variation
Would reconfirm variation without distinguishing its source
Measures complete input, loaded state and RNG provenance with minimal new policy execution

conditions: Unchanged frozen V3 evaluator path/hash and final080000 checkpoint; EGL, current precision/config; no seeding before model load or reset in baseline measurement because that would change the tested protocol. Both calls use the same captured preprocessed batch with restored CPU/CUDA/NumPy/Python RNG and reset policy state; do not step environment with predicted actions.

analysis_rules: Cross-process input differences support H_input but do not establish why inputs changed
